title: 點歌 Tiám-kua
mood: thirty years of listening and one night of being heard
subject: a father who listened to a midnight radio request show for thirty years and never called in
caption: Taiwanese Hokkien folk rock with pipa as the lead instrument. Pipa playing fast tremolo and sharp plucked attacks as the main melodic voice set against the band, large hand cymbals and small bells adding metallic accents inside the kit, steel-string acoustic guitar strummed steadily, drum kit and electric bass driving underneath. Folk-rock band sound with the pipa mixed forward and dry rather than treated as colour. Female voice, direct and warm, plain-spoken with traditional breath placement and no weeping ornament. 124 BPM, E minor pentatonic. Thirty years of listening and one night of being heard. No synth, no suona, no enka-style vibrato, no ballad section, no key change.
lyrics:
[Verse]
半暝十二點 電台有一个點歌的節目
阮阿爸逐暗聽 聽三十冬
伊毋捌點過 伊講「聽別人點就好」
三十冬 攏毋捌點

[Chorus]
點歌
彼个節目逐暗攏有人咧講家己的代誌
講予一个毋捌面的主持人聽
講予規个暗暝攏睏袂去的人聽
阮阿爸毋捌講 伊干焦聽

[Verse]
阿爸七十歲生日 阮家己打電話入去
阮講「我欲點予阮阿爸」 主持人問「伊叫啥物名」
阮講出來 阮聽著家己的聲佇收音機內底
阮越頭看 阿爸無講話 伊共音量轉大

[Chorus]
點歌
彼个節目逐暗攏有人咧講家己的代誌
講予一个毋捌面的主持人聽
講予規个暗暝攏睏袂去的人聽
彼暗 阮阿爸是彼个予人點的人

[Outro]
歌煞 伊才講一句
「你按怎知我愛這條」
